author: A Vox in the Void
description:
'Maledictum' - a Warhammer horror anthology

'Maledictum' is the result of a horror competition ran through the official A Vox in the Void Discord channel. With the help of my trusted Discord members Tyler, Soul and Green these entries were chosen as the eventual winners. 

I Want - Written by Ordo Manifest
The Horror in the Herd - Written by Andrew Ottley
The Paradox of Hope - Written by SaggioMik

Thank you to everyone who entered the competition, they were all so fantastically written it was an incredible tough choice. All entries will be featured in a special 'Vox Populi' online magazine. 

Join the Discord!

https://discord.gg/brv5F5z8Hv

All stories narrated and produced by A Vox in the Void.
